subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` merge contract, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or keep Anthropic beta flags internal?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new public config surfaces and this choice determines the long-term provider request-body contract.

options.title: Add Bedrock request-field merge contract
options.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned, schema-validated merge point for vendor request fields and document merge/de-dup semantics for `anthropic_beta`.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta option
options.body: Support a typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path while avoiding a broad arbitrary request-field passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom beta config
options.body: Keep beta flags internal and require first-class provider support for each Bedrock beta field instead of allowing user config to send arbitrary vendor fields.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock request-field merge contract
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned, schema-validated merge point for vendor request fields and document merge/de-dup semantics for `anthropic_beta`.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the Bedrock stream/request-field and provider-registration paths that would own this decision.
